# Hi, I'm Luca 👋

M.Sc. student in Applied Psychology at the University of Trieste,
working at the intersection of statistical genomics and computational
psychiatry.

I spent time at the [Behavior, Environment, and Genetics
Lab](https://sites.wustl.edu/emmajohnsonlab/) (WashU St. Louis),
working on the genomics of psychosis and Bayesian transcriptomic
modelling.

## Research Interests

::: {.research-list}
- Psychiatric genomics — psychosis, neurodevelopment
- Statistical genomics for complex traits
- Bayesian hierarchical modelling of biological trajectories
- Longitudinal genetic models of development
:::
